title: AlgorithmConfig
description: Algorithm type and per-algorithm configuration used for a scheduling run. This schema is active: it is referenced by schedule_metadata.schema.json and accepts current EST, LST, multi-cursor, and HAP metadata shapes.

BeamFom.description: Figure-of-merit function used to score and rank candidate placements.

EstConfig.description: Configuration parameters for the Earliest-Start-Time beam-search scheduler.

k_beams.description: Number of schedule states (beams) kept alive after each expansion round. k=1 gives classic greedy EST.

branching_factor.description: Number of distinct candidates tried per beam per round. b=1 disables branching.

endangered_threshold.description: Residual-flexibility threshold below which a task is promoted ahead of others. 0 disables the protection.

LstConfig.description: Configuration parameters for the Latest-Start-Time beam-search scheduler. LST shares the EST beam knobs but runs as a single backward cursor.

k_beams.description: Number of schedule states (beams) kept alive after each expansion round.

branching_factor.description: Number of distinct candidates tried per beam per round.

endangered_threshold.description: Residual-flexibility threshold below which a task is promoted ahead of others. 0 disables the protection.

MultiCursorConfig.description: Configuration parameters for a multi-cursor beam-search run.

k_beams.description: Number of schedule states (beams) kept alive after each expansion round.

branching_factor.description: Number of distinct candidates tried per beam per round.

endangered_threshold.description: Residual-flexibility threshold below which a task is promoted ahead of others. 0 disables the protection.

HapConfig.description: Configuration parameters for the Hybrid Adaptive metaheuristic scheduler. Accepts both the current lab-run metadata shape and the legacy standalone shape.

rho.description: Window selection stochasticity: pick uniformly from the best N windows.

num_crus.description: Number of parallel Constructive Repair Units (CRUs) and survivor schedules.

cru_max_iterations.description: Maximum repair iterations per CRU run.

rho.description: Window selection stochasticity: pick uniformly from the best N windows.

random_seed.description: Master seed used for per-CRU RNG derivation.

impatience_alpha.description: Impatience scaling factor (denominator) controlling how quickly tasks become urgent.
